drafts.draft_text: We're sorry to hear that your meal didn't meet your expectations - the underseasoned flavors and overcooked texture are not what we aim for. We're reviewing our kitchen procedures to catch any issues before food leaves the kitchen, re-training our staff on customer service basics, and doing a deep clean of the bathrooms this week. — The team
